Every number cited to research/<file>.md is in that file outside the conclusion markers; the only exceptions are 10 blocks of shown arithmetic or Д-marked values, which I confirmed. Every ideas/05 and ideas/README quote in the table at L189-199 is verbatim; the owner-goals and REQ-005 quotes (L20-22, L636-639) are verbatim.

The item also offers 'only the kit' as the alternative to diverging forms, yet the kit is also sold to companies.
